title: Instance-Specific Test-Time Training for Speech Editing in the Wild

layout.note: Three lettered panels side by side in a 2.6:1 strip, captions underneath. (a), the widest, is a bottom-up stack of three modules between two tinted zoom insets (peach at the left, green at the right) tied to their modules by dashed wedges; (b) and (c) are narrower bottom-up flows with strips of embeddings or mel-spectrograms, a module with a flame or snowflake icon and loss symbols at the top or right.

lesson: Draw an adaptation procedure by reusing the same data strips in each panel and marking what changes: red for the user's edit region, yellow for the extra random mask, flame and snowflake icons for what is updated or frozen, and the loss symbols at the ends of the arrows.
